title: 6 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 6 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Acquaint yourself to the concepts underlying Ashtanga yoga , Hatha yoga and Vinyasa flow and lead yourself towards the path of self-discovery and discovery of the Divine through 6 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali organized exclusively by Bali Yoga School
summary: A 6 days / 5 nights yoga retreat in Canggu that you can start on any day of the week, covering pranayama, soft Hatha, dynamic Vinyasa, mantra and chakra meditation, Yoga Nidra and sound baths.
intro: Master the Art of Mindful Living with our 6 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu, Bali. Six days – A full weekly cycle of transformation. Our 6-day Canggu retreat is the sweet spot between the depth of immersion and the time needed in practice: long enough to change, organized enough to fit into the busy schedules.

Unlike retreats that force artificial starting points, you choose your entry into our rich seven-day cycle. Begin Thursday with powerful Kapalabhati pranayama and dynamic Vinyasa, flow through weekend gentleness and beach meditations, then complete your journey with Monday’s centering Om mantra practice.

Six days will give you a taste of all our pranayama methods – the balancing Dirga breath, the energizing Ujjayi, the calming Anulom Vilom, the warming Surya Bhedi practice. You will learn not only how to restore with the help of soft Hatha practices but also to energize with the help of dynamic Vinyasa flows, all of which are based on genuine traditional principles.
